text:
Sam: I put the IO cache eviction postmortem up (IO-CACHE-2026). We need to convert remediation bullets into concrete tests, tickets, and owners so we don't lose momentum. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/io-cache-2026

Priya: Agreed. Suggest we split into small tickets: (1) deterministic replay regression, (2) sustained 90m working-set load, (3) promptset + eval additions, (4) one controlled chaos run. I can create the perf tickets and track priorities.

Marta: I can own the regression harness. Plan: implement a trace-replay runner and a pressure-toggle stress scenario. Deliverables: PR with tests + README, wire a nightly CI job. ETA 9 business days.

Kai: Infra: I'll extract two representative traces and run a scrub job (remove IDs/PII). I'll drop sanitized trace-v4 bundles in s3://incidents/io-eviction/samples and post links. ETA ~48h. I'll also request a temporary infra quota bump for the 90m run.

Taylor: I'll take promptsets and evals. Two promptsets: `eviction-short-context` and `eviction-long-context`. Eval acceptance: P95 latency <= 1.25x baseline and correctness delta <= 0.5%. I'll add eval-runner jobs and golden baselines. ETA 6 days.

Priya: Creating PERF-5305 "eviction-sustained-90m" and PERF-5306 "eviction-regression-harness" now. I'll link both to the postmortem and tag infra/finance for quota/budget. Ticket links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PERF-5305 and /PERF-5306

ops-bot: PERF-5305 and PERF-5306 created and associated with IO-CACHE-2026. CI template `eviction-suite-nightly` available.

Marta: Naming & labels so tests are discoverable:
```
tests/eviction/
  - kv_eviction_replay.yaml    # deterministic incident replay
  - kv_eviction_90m_workingset.yaml  # sustained working-set ramp
labels: ["regression","eviction","kv","chaos","nightly"]
```

Marta: I'll open the harness PR once Kai posts sanitized traces. PR checklist I'll maintain: 1) harness + tests, 2) sanitized traces attached, 3) CI job wiring, 4) perf ticket linked, 5) acceptance criteria doc.

Kai: Scrubbed bundles will be attached to PERF-5306 in ~48h. I'll also ping infra-schedule for the temporary quota and add the request to PERF-5305.

Sam: Chaos run plan: tabletop first (30m) then one controlled staging eviction run. Marta lead the live run, Kai handles staging signals & quotas, Taylor runs evals during the run. I'll schedule the tabletop for next Tue 11:00 and invite the ops rotation.

Priya: Dependencies logged in tickets: sanitized traces, infra quota bump, and CI minutes budget. I've CC'd finance and infra-schedule. Please add any extra dependencies to the perf tickets.

Taylor: I'll commit promptset examples and a small runner script to compare output to the golden baseline in the PR.

Marta: Quick owners recap: Marta -> regression harness & live chaos; Taylor -> promptsets + eval baselines; Kai -> sanitized traces + infra; Priya -> perf tickets + scheduling; Sam -> tabletop facilitation + follow-up.

Priya: ETAs posted in PERF-5305/5306: Marta(9 days), Taylor(6 days), Kai(2 days), Priya(14 days for orchestration), Sam(schedule this week).

ops-bot: CI job `eviction-suite-nightly` scheduled to run daily at 03:15 UTC after relevant PRs merge.

Sam: I'll convert this thread into the postmortem follow-up doc and link PERF-5305/5306 + the harness PR once opened. Thanks team — please update ticket checklists as you make progress. :thumbsup:
